Crystal Diffraction  晶体衍射

Crystal Diffraction  晶体衍射

  • To study the Bragg law of diffraction
    研究布拉格衍射定律
  • To show diffraction directions are determined solely by the shape and size of the unit cell.
    说明衍射方向完全由单位晶胞的形状和大小决定。
  • To briefly introduce some diffraction methods.
    简要介绍一些衍射方法。
  • To show the positions of atoms within a unit cell can be known from intensities of diffracted beams.
    说明通过衍射光束的强度可以知道单胞内原子的位置。

Crystal Diffraction-Bragg Law
晶体衍射--布拉格定律

Bragg Law  布拉格定律

  • The wavelength of X X XX-rays is typically 1 Å 1 Å 1"Å"1 \AA, comparable to interatomic spacing in solids.
    X X XX -射线的波长通常为 1 Å 1 Å 1"Å"1 \AA ，与固体中的原子间距相当。
  • This means that a crystal behaves as a threedimensional diffraction grating for X -rays.
    这意味着晶体对 X 射线而言就像一个三维衍射光栅。
  • Bragg derived the condition for constructive interference of the X-rays scattered from a set of parallel lattice planes.
    布拉格得出了一组平行晶格平面散射的 X 射线发生建设性干涉的条件。

Crystal Diffraction-Bragg Law
晶体衍射--布拉格定律

Optical Grating  光学光栅

Path difference X Y X Y XYX Y between diffracted beams 1 and 2 :
衍射光束 1 和 2 之间的路径差 X Y X Y XYX Y ：
sin ⁡ ϕ = X Y / d sin ⁡ ϕ = X Y / d sin phi=XY//d\sin \phi=X Y / d
⇒ X Y = d sin ⁡ ϕ ⇒ X Y = d sin ⁡ ϕ =>XY=d sin phi\Rightarrow X Y=d \sin \phi

要使 1 和 2 相位一致并产生建设性干扰， XY = λ , 2 λ , 3 λ , 4 λ … . n λ XY = λ , 2 λ , 3 λ , 4 λ … . n λ XY=lambda,2lambda,3lambda,4lambda dots.nlambda\mathrm{XY}=\lambda, 2 \lambda, 3 \lambda, 4 \lambda \ldots . \mathrm{n} \lambda
so  那么
d sin ⁡ ϕ = n λ d sin ⁡ ϕ = n λ dsin phi=nlambdaquad\mathrm{d} \sin \phi=\mathrm{n} \lambda \quad where n is the order of diffraction

Optical Grating  光学光栅

  • Consequences: maximum value of λ λ lambda\lambda for diffraction sin ⁡ ϕ = 1 ⇒ d = λ sin ⁡ ϕ = 1 ⇒ d = λ sin phi=1=>d=lambda\sin \phi=1 \Rightarrow d=\lambda
    结果：衍射 λ λ lambda\lambda 的最大值 sin ⁡ ϕ = 1 ⇒ d = λ sin ⁡ ϕ = 1 ⇒ d = λ sin phi=1=>d=lambda\sin \phi=1 \Rightarrow d=\lambda
  • Realistically, sin ⁡ ϕ < 1 ⇒ d > λ sin ⁡ ϕ < 1 ⇒ d > λ sin phi < 1=>d > lambda\sin \phi<1 \Rightarrow d>\lambda So separation must be same order as, but greater than, wavelength of light.
    从现实角度看， sin ⁡ ϕ < 1 ⇒ d > λ sin ⁡ ϕ < 1 ⇒ d > λ sin phi < 1=>d > lambda\sin \phi<1 \Rightarrow d>\lambda 因此分离度必须与光波长相同，但大于光波长。
  • Thus for diffraction from crystals: Interatomic distances 0.1-2 Å Å "Å"\AA, so λ = 0.1 − 2 Å λ = 0.1 − 2 Å lambda=0.1-2"Å"\lambda=0.1-2 \AA
    因此，对于晶体衍射而言：原子间距离 0.1-2 Å Å "Å"\AA ，因此 λ = 0.1 − 2 Å λ = 0.1 − 2 Å lambda=0.1-2"Å"\lambda=0.1-2 \AA
  • X-rays, electrons, neutrons suitable
    适合的 X 射线、电子、中子

N th N th  N^("th ")\mathbf{N}^{\text {th }}-order of diffraction

  • A beam corresponding to a value of n n n\boldsymbol{n} greater than 1 :
    与 n n n\boldsymbol{n} 值大于 1 相对应的光束：
    “nth-order diffraction” from the (hkl) planes.
    hkl）平面的 "n 次衍射"。
  • Such a beam is described more concisely as the ( n h n k n l n h n k n l nhnknln h n k n l ) diffraction.
    这种光束更简洁地描述为 ( n h n k n l n h n k n l nhnknln h n k n l ) 衍射。
Example: The third-order diffraction from the (111) plane is described as ( 33 3) diffraction.
举例说明：来自 (111) 平面的三阶衍射描述为 ( 33 3) 衍射。
2 d sin ⁡ θ = n λ 2 d sin ⁡ θ = n λ 2dsin theta=nlambda2 \mathrm{~d} \sin \theta=\mathrm{n} \lambda
This notation is justified by rewriting the Bragg law as
将布拉格定律重写为
2 ( d / n ) sin ⁡ θ = λ 2 ( d / n ) sin ⁡ θ = λ 2(d//n)sin theta=lambda2(d / n) \sin \theta=\lambda
which makes nth order diffraction off ( h k l h k l hklh \boldsymbol{k} l ) planes of spacing d d dd look like first order diffraction of planes of spacing d / n d / n d//nd / n. Planes of this reduced spacing would have Miller indices ( n h n k n l n h n k n l nhnknln h n k n l ).
这使得间距为 d d dd 的平面的 n 阶衍射（ h k l h k l hklh \boldsymbol{k} l ）看起来像间距为 d / n d / n d//nd / n 的平面的一阶衍射。间距缩小的平面将具有米勒指数 ( n h n k n l n h n k n l nhnknln h n k n l )。
In practice we need only consider the n = 1 n = 1 n=1\mathbf{n}=\mathbf{1} value, since the n = 2 n = 2 n=2\mathbf{n}=\mathbf{2} and higher values for the (hkl) planes correspond to the n = 1 n = 1 n=1\mathbf{n}=\mathbf{1} value for the ( n h n k n l n h n k n l nhnknl\mathbf{n h} \mathbf{n k} \mathbf{n l} ) planes, and this would be redundant.
实际上，我们只需考虑 n = 1 n = 1 n=1\mathbf{n}=\mathbf{1} 值，因为 (hkl) 平面的 n = 2 n = 2 n=2\mathbf{n}=\mathbf{2} 及更高值对应于 ( n h n k n l n h n k n l nhnknl\mathbf{n h} \mathbf{n k} \mathbf{n l} ) 平面的 n = 1 n = 1 n=1\mathbf{n}=\mathbf{1} 值，这将是多余的。

Crystal Diffraction-Bragg Law
晶体衍射--布拉格定律

Some important notes on Bragg Law
关于布拉格法的一些重要说明

  • The diffracted beams from any set of lattice plane can only occur at the particular angles predicted by Bragg’s law.
    任何一组晶格平面的衍射光束都只能以布拉格定律预测的特定角度出现。
  • The Bragg law is a consequence of the periodicity of the lattice.
    布拉格定律是晶格周期性的结果。
  • Bragg law does not refer to the composition of the basis of atoms associated with every lattice point.
    布拉格定律并不是指与每个晶格点相关的原子基础组成。
  • The composition of the basis determines the relative intensity of the diffraction from a given set of parallel planes.
    基础的组成决定了特定平行平面衍射的相对强度。
  • Bragg law is a necessary but not a sufficient condition for diffraction of real crystals
    布拉格定律是实际晶体衍射的必要条件，但不是充分条件

Example 9: Structure Factor for FCC structure

S h k l = ∑ j f j exp ⁡ [ − 2 π i ( h x j + k y j + l z j ) ] S h k l = ∑ j   f j exp ⁡ − 2 π i h x j + k y j + l z j S_(hkl)=sum_(j)f_(j)exp[-2pi i(hx_(j)+ky_(j)+lz_(j))]S_{h k l}=\sum_{j} f_{j} \exp \left[-2 \pi i\left(h x_{j}+k y_{j}+l z_{j}\right)\right]
Atomic position: (0,0,0), (0,1/2, 1/2), (1/2,0, 1/2), (1/2,1/2,0)
原子位置：(0,0,0), (0,1/2, 1/2), (1/2,0, 1/2), (1/2,1/2,0)
S h k l = f [ e − 2 π i ( 0 ) + e − π i ( k + l ) + e − π i ( h + l ) + e − π i ( h + k ) ] = f [ 1 + e − π i ( k + l ) + e − π i ( h + l ) + e − π i ( h + k ) ] S h k l = f e − 2 π i ( 0 ) + e − π i ( k + l ) + e − π i ( h + l ) + e − π i ( h + k ) = f 1 + e − π i ( k + l ) + e − π i ( h + l ) + e − π i ( h + k ) {:[S_(hkl)=f[e^(-2pi i(0))+e^(-pi i(k+l))+e^(-pi i(h+l))+e^(-pi i(h+k))]],[=f[1+e^(-pi i(k+l))+e^(-pi i(h+l))+e^(-pi i(h+k))]]:}\begin{aligned} S_{h k l} & =f\left[e^{-2 \pi i(0)}+e^{-\pi i(k+l)}+e^{-\pi i(h+l)}+e^{-\pi i(h+k)}\right] \\ & =f\left[1+e^{-\pi i(k+l)}+e^{-\pi i(h+l)}+e^{-\pi i(h+k)}\right] \end{aligned}
S = 4 f S = 4 f S=4fS=4 f for unmixed indices (i.e. all indices are odd integers or all indices are even integers);
S = 4 f S = 4 f S=4fS=4 f 表示不混合索引（即所有索引都是奇数整数或所有索引都是偶数整数）；
S = 0 S = 0 S=0quadS=0 \quad for mixed indices (i.e. whether two of the indices are odd and one even, or two even and one odd)
S = 0 S = 0 S=0quadS=0 \quad 表示混合指数（即两个指数是奇数，一个指数是偶数，还是两个指数是偶数，一个指数是奇数）。
Diffractions will occur for such planes as (111), (200), and (220) but not for the planes (100), (210), (112), etc.
(111)、(200)和(220)等平面会发生衍射，但(100)、(210)和(112)等平面不会发生衍射。

Bragg’s Law is a necessary but not a sufficient condition for efficient diffraction because diffraction involves interaction of X-ray with the electrons in the crystal.
布拉格定律是有效衍射的必要条件，但不是充分条件，因为衍射涉及 X 射线与晶体中电子的相互作用。
To determine whether there will be a diffraction peak from a set of plans in a crystal we also have to consider the distributions of the atoms and their electrons in the crystal. We can obtain this information through structure factor.
要确定晶体中的一组图纸是否会出现衍射峰，我们还必须考虑晶体中原子及其电子的分布情况。我们可以通过结构因子获得这些信息。

Crystal Diffraction  晶体衍射

What is the difference between diffraction and reflection
衍射和反射有何区别

In the derivation of Bragg’s law we treat the planes of atoms as mirrors that can reflect the x-rays. This analogy between diffraction and reflection simplifies the derivation: we are all familiar with the reflection of visible light. The angle the incident x-ray beam makes with the lattice planes is the same as that made by the diffracted beam, so there is a qualitative similarity between diffraction of x x xx-rays and reflection of visible light. Diffraction and reflection however, are actually different phenomena. Some important differences are listed here.
在布拉格定律的推导过程中，我们将原子平面视为可以反射 X 射线的镜子。衍射和反射之间的这种类比简化了推导过程：我们都熟悉可见光的反射。入射的 X 射线光束与晶格平面所成的角度与衍射光束所成的角度相同，因此 x x xx -射线的衍射与可见光的反射在本质上是相似的。然而，衍射和反射实际上是不同的现象。这里列出了一些重要的区别。
  • The diffracted beam is composed of waves that have been scattered by all the atoms of the crystal lying in the path of the incident beam. Reflection of visible light is a surface phenomenon occurring in a layer about λ / 2 λ / 2 lambda//2\lambda / 2 thick.
    衍射光束由位于入射光束路径上的所有晶体原子散射的波组成。可见光的反射是一种表面现象，发生在约 λ / 2 λ / 2 lambda//2\lambda / 2 厚的层中。
  • The diffraction of x-rays of a single wavelength takes place only at certain angles, θ θ theta\theta (known as the Bragg angle), where there is constructive interference and Bragg’s law is thus satisfied. The reflection of visible light takes place at any angle of incidence.
    单一波长 X 射线的衍射只发生在特定角度 θ θ theta\theta （称为布拉格角），在该角度存在建设性干涉，因此符合布拉格定律。可见光的反射在任何入射角都会发生。
  • The intensity of the beam of visible light reflected by a good mirror is almost the same as the intensity of the incident beam. The intensity of a diffracted beam of x x xx-rays from a crystal is extremely small compared to that of the incident beam.
    好镜子反射的可见光光束强度几乎与入射光束强度相同。与入射光束相比，晶体衍射出的 x x xx 射线束的强度极小。
  • In reflection, the angle of incidence (or reflection) is defined as the angle between the normal to the specimen surface and the incident (or reflected) beam. In diffraction, the angle of the incident beam (or the diffracted one) is defined as the angle between the specimen surface and the incident (or diffracted) beam.
    在反射过程中，入射角（或反射角）被定义为试样表面的法线与入射（或反射）光束之间的夹角。在衍射中，入射光束（或衍射光束）的角度定义为试样表面与入射光束（或衍射光束）之间的角度。

Crystal Diffraction-Summary
晶体衍射--摘要

  1. Why X-ray and not visible light is used for studying crystal diffraction?
    为什么用 X 射线而不是可见光来研究晶体衍射？
  2. Derive Bragg’s law by using simple case of incident X-ray beams being diffracted by parallel planes in a crystal.
    利用入射 X 射线光束被晶体中的平行平面衍射的简单情况，推导布拉格定律。
  3. Distinguish between destructive interference and constructive interference of reflected X-ray beams through crystals.
    区分晶体反射 X 射线束的破坏性干涉和建设性干涉。
  4. What is meant by “first set of principal allowed diffraction plane” and “first order diffraction”?
    什么是 "第一组主允许衍射面 "和 "一阶衍射"？
  5. Why Bragg law is a necessary but not a sufficient condition for diffraction of real crystals
    为什么布拉格定律是实际晶体衍射的必要条件而非充分条件？
  6. What determined the diffraction directions?
    是什么决定了衍射方向？
  7. List the ten principal planes in the ascending order of ( h 2 + k 2 + l 2 ) h 2 + k 2 + l 2 (h^(2)+k^(2)+l^(2))\left(h^{2}+k^{2}+l^{2}\right).
    按照 ( h 2 + k 2 + l 2 ) h 2 + k 2 + l 2 (h^(2)+k^(2)+l^(2))\left(h^{2}+k^{2}+l^{2}\right) 的升序列出十个主平面。
  8. Give the first two set of principal allowed diffraction planes in BCC. What is the physical interpretation that (100) reflection vanishes for bcc lattice?
    给出 BCC 中允许的前两组主衍射面。对 BCC 晶格来说，（100）反射消失的物理解释是什么？
  9. Name three kinds of diffraction methods and their principal operation.
    说出三种衍射方法及其主要操作。

    10.写出结构因子的一般方程。

Band Theory - Energy Concepts
带状理论--能量概念

  • So far, we have considered only the potential energy. What if the electron is not stationary (i.e., it has finite velocity & hence kinetic energy)?
    到目前为止，我们只考虑了势能。如果电子不是静止的（即具有有限的速度和动能）呢？
    -Consider an electron initially at rest in vacuum next to the LH plate where V V VV = 0 V = 0 V =0V=0 \mathrm{~V}.
    -考虑一个最初静止在 LH 板旁真空中的电子，其中 V V VV = 0 V = 0 V =0V=0 \mathrm{~V} 。
    -If the electron is free to move, it will be attracted towards the +ve RH plate - it is accelerated by the electric field between the plates.
    -如果电子可以自由移动，它将被吸引到 +ve RH 板上 - 它被板间的电场加速。
    -The electron energy gains K.E. ( E K E = 1 / 2 m 0 v 2 ) E K E = 1 / 2 m 0 v 2 (E_(KE)=1//2m_(0)v^(2))\left(E_{K E}=1 / 2 m_{0} v^{2}\right) at the expense of a drop in potential energy.
    ( E K E = 1 / 2 m 0 v 2 ) E K E = 1 / 2 m 0 v 2 (E_(KE)=1//2m_(0)v^(2))\left(E_{K E}=1 / 2 m_{0} v^{2}\right) 电子能量以势能下降为代价获得 K.E. ( E K E = 1 / 2 m 0 v 2 ) E K E = 1 / 2 m 0 v 2 (E_(KE)=1//2m_(0)v^(2))\left(E_{K E}=1 / 2 m_{0} v^{2}\right) 。
    -The total energy of the electron remains the same as when it started:
    -电子的总能量与开始时相同：
E t o t = E P E + E K E E t o t = E P E + E K E E_(tot)=E_(PE)+E_(KE)E_{t o t}=E_{P E}+E_{K E}

Band Theory - Energy Concepts
带状理论--能量概念

-So far, we have considered only the potential energy. What if the electron is not stationary (i.e., it has finite velocity & hence kinetic energy)?
-到目前为止，我们只考虑了势能。如果电子不是静止的（即具有有限的速度和动能）呢？
-Consider an electron initially at rest in vacuum next to the LH plate where V V VV = 0 V = 0 V =0V=0 \mathrm{~V}.
-考虑一个最初静止在 LH 板旁真空中的电子，其中 V V VV = 0 V = 0 V =0V=0 \mathrm{~V} 。
-If the electron is free to move, it will be attracted towards the +ve RH plate - it is accelerated by the electric field between the plates.
-如果电子可以自由移动，它将被吸引到 +ve RH 板 - 它被板间的电场加速。
-The electron energy gains K.E. ( E K E = 1 / 2 m 0 v 2 ) E K E = 1 / 2 m 0 v 2 (E_(KE)=1//2m_(0)v^(2))\left(E_{K E}=1 / 2 m_{0} v^{2}\right) at the expense of a drop in potential energy.
( E K E = 1 / 2 m 0 v 2 ) E K E = 1 / 2 m 0 v 2 (E_(KE)=1//2m_(0)v^(2))\left(E_{K E}=1 / 2 m_{0} v^{2}\right) 电子能量以势能下降为代价获得 K.E. ( E K E = 1 / 2 m 0 v 2 ) E K E = 1 / 2 m 0 v 2 (E_(KE)=1//2m_(0)v^(2))\left(E_{K E}=1 / 2 m_{0} v^{2}\right) 。
-The total energy of the electron remains the same as when it started:
-电子的总能量与开始时相同：
E t o t = E P E + E K E E t o t = E P E + E K E E_(tot)=E_(PE)+E_(KE)E_{t o t}=E_{P E}+E_{K E}

Band Theory - Energy Concepts
带状理论--能量概念

-In the previous example, the total energy of the electron started at 0 eV and remained the same throughout since energy is conserved.
-在前面的例子中，电子的总能量从 0 eV 开始，由于能量守恒，所以始终保持不变。
-Consider what happens if the electron meets a collision (say with a gas molecule) halfway, and, say, it loses all its kinetic energy as a result of that collision.
-想一想，如果电子在中途遇到碰撞（比如说与气体分子），并且由于碰撞而失去了全部动能，会发生什么情况？
  • Just after the collision, its KE will be zero, but it will start accelerating and increase its KE.
    碰撞后，它的 KE 值为零，但会开始加速并增加 KE 值。
    -Note that in this case, the total energy of the electron drops as a result of the collision.
    -注意，在这种情况下，电子的总能量会因碰撞而下降。

Band Theory - Energy Concepts
带状理论--能量概念

-We can extrapolate what happens if the electron meets many collisions (e.g. with many gas molecules in a less-than-perfect vacuum) along the way.
-我们可以推断出，如果电子沿途遇到多次碰撞（例如在不太完美的真空中与许多气体分子碰撞）会发生什么情况。
-If the electron loses a large portion of its KE in each collision, then the average KE (and corresponding average speed) of the electron will be very low.
-如果电子在每次碰撞中都会损失很大一部分 KE 值，那么电子的平均 KE 值（以及相应的平均速度）就会非常低。
-The total energy of the electron will decrease along the way.
-电子的总能量会沿途减少。
-Clearly, the more collisions there are along the way, the lower the average KE / speed of the electron, and the greater the rate of energy loss.
-很明显，一路上的碰撞越多，电子的平均 KE 值/速度就越低，能量损失率就越大。
-With a great number of collisions, most of the energy will be “lost” and E tot ∼ E P E E tot  ∼ E P E E_("tot ")∼E_(PE)E_{\text {tot }} \sim E_{P E}.
-随着碰撞次数的增加，大部分能量都会 "损失"， E tot ∼ E P E E tot  ∼ E P E E_("tot ")∼E_(PE)E_{\text {tot }} \sim E_{P E} 。

Band Theory - Energy Concepts
带状理论--能量概念

1.2 Workfunction of a Metal Surface
1.2 金属表面的工作功能

-In our simple model of “free” electrons in a metal, the valence electrons from the constituent atoms are delocalized from the parent atoms (ions) which allow them to be mobile and conduct electricity.
-在我们简单的金属 "自由 "电子模型中，组成原子的价电子从母体原子（离子）中分离出来，使它们能够移动和导电。
-These electrons are not truly “free” in the sense than an electron in vacuum is free.
-与真空中的电子相比，这些电子并不是真正 "自由 "的。
-While the conduction electrons can move around in the metal, they are still attracted by charges (positive metal ions and other electrons) in the metal.
-虽然传导电子可以在金属中移动，但它们仍然会被金属中的电荷（正金属离子和其他电子）吸引。
-The energy required* to extract a conduction electron from a metal into vacuum is called the workfunction of the metal.
-将传导电子从金属中提取到真空中所需的能量*称为金属的功函数。
  • Some typical metal workfunctions:
    一些典型的金属加工功能：

Band Theory - Energy Concepts
带状理论--能量概念

-If we compare a (stationary) electron in vacuum, to a (stationary) electron in the metal at the same potential (voltage), the energy of the electron in the metal is lower by an amount equivalent to the workfunction.
-如果我们将真空中的（静止）电子与金属中处于相同电位（电压）的（静止）电子进行比较，则金属中电子的能量较低，低的量相当于功函数。
-Returning to our illustration of the parallel plate capacitor, now let us place a bar of metal between the two electrodes so that the metal is biased.
-回到平行板电容器的示意图，现在让我们在两个电极之间放置一根金属棒，使金属处于偏置状态。
-We can compare the potential energy of a conduction electron in the metal, and the energy of an electron in vacuum at the same position between the plates (assume workfunction = 4.0 eV = 4.0 eV =4.0eV=4.0 \mathrm{eV} )
-我们可以比较金属中传导电子的势能和真空中电子在两板间相同位置的能量（假设工作函数 = 4.0 eV = 4.0 eV =4.0eV=4.0 \mathrm{eV} )

Band Theory - Energy Concepts
带状理论--能量概念

-The potential energy an electron has in vacuum is represented by the vacuum level.
-电子在真空中的势能用真空度表示。
-If we assume that a conduction electron in the metal starts at rest from the LH end of the bar, its initial total energy is -4.0 eV (relative to the vacuum level).
-如果我们假设金属中的传导电子从棒的 LH 端开始静止，那么它的初始总能量为 -4.0eV（相对于真空水平）。
-The electron is accelerated by the electric field, but it does not gain much velocity before it undergoes a scattering event. The mean free path is typically of the order of nm. Hence the average KE remains very small*.
-电子被电场加速，但在发生散射事件之前，它的速度并没有增加多少。平均自由路径通常为纳米量级。因此，平均 KE 仍然非常小*。
-The resulting total energy ( PE + KE PE + KE PE+KE\mathrm{PE}+\mathrm{KE} ) is thus nearly equal to to the PE. Most of the energy is dissipated as heat.
-由此产生的总能量（ PE + KE PE + KE PE+KE\mathrm{PE}+\mathrm{KE} ）几乎与 PE 相等。大部分能量以热量形式耗散。
  • additional KE gained from the E-field, on top of the KE due to the random velocity of the electron
    在电子随机速度产生的 KE 之外，从 E 场获得的额外 KE

带状理论--能量概念

2.Energy Levels in Atoms
2.原子的能级

1. Bohr Atomic Model
1.玻尔原子模型

Simplified Bohr atomic model (1913):
简化的玻尔原子模型（1913 年）：
-Electrons exist in orbits of fixed radii around the nucleus.
-电子以固定半径围绕原子核运行。
  • Over a period of time, the electron would appear as a spherical negativelycharged shell (hence the name “shell model”).
    经过一段时间后，电子会呈现出一个球形的带负电外壳（因此被称为 "外壳模型"）。
Bohr atomic model for hydrogen
玻尔氢原子模型

Band Theory - Energy Concepts
带状理论--能量概念

-For a hydrogen atom in the ground state (lowest possible energy configuration), its single electron will be in the n = 1 n = 1 n=1n=1 shell, where its energy is -13.6 eV .
-对于处于基态（可能的最低能量构型）的氢原子，其单个电子位于 n = 1 n = 1 n=1n=1 壳中，能量为 -13.6 eV。
-The electron can be excited into higher energy levels corresponding to more distant shells.
-电子可以被激发到对应于更远外壳的更高能级。
-To free the electron from the nucleus (i.e., infinite separation), you need to supply +13.6 eV of energy to the electron. The energy of the freed stationary (no K.E.) electron is at the vacuum level (energy = 0 eV = 0 eV =0eV=0 \mathrm{eV} if V = 0 V = 0 V=0V=0 ).
-要将电子从原子核中释放出来（即无限分离），需要为电子提供 +13.6 eV 的能量。被释放的静止（无 K.E.）电子的能量处于真空水平（能量 = 0 eV = 0 eV =0eV=0 \mathrm{eV} 如果 V = 0 V = 0 V=0V=0 ）。

Band Theory - Energy Levels in Atoms
能带理论--原子中的能级

-For large shell numbers, the radius becomes large ( ∝ n 2 ∝ n 2 propn^(2)\propto n^{2} ), while the energy of the electron increases (from -ve) towards 0 eV (at the vacuum level).
-对于大的壳数，半径会变大（ ∝ n 2 ∝ n 2 propn^(2)\propto n^{2} ），而电子的能量（从-ve）增加到 0 eV（真空水平）。

1. Electron Configuration
1.电子构型

Motion of electrons in atoms is more complicated in reality:
原子中电子的运动在现实中更为复杂：
-The exact position of an electron cannot be determined exactly.
-电子的确切位置无法准确确定。
  • Electrons can have non-circular orbits.
    电子可以有非圆形轨道。
    -Electron charge density is used to represent the position of the electron in its orbital motion around the nucleus.
    -电子电荷密度用于表示电子在围绕原子核的轨道运动中的位置。

-The energy level of the shell generally increases with shell number (i.e. further away from the nucleus).
-壳的能级一般随壳数（即离核越远）的增加而增加。
-In an atom at ground state (lowest possible energy), electrons occupy the lowest possible energy states. This gives the electron configuration of the atom.
-原子在基态（可能的最低能量）时，电子占据可能的最低能量状态。这就是原子的电子构型。

-The electrons in the outermost shell or the valence shell are called the valence electrons§.
-最外层或价层中的电子称为价电子§。
-The valence shell has the greatest influence on the properties of the atom, since the valence electrons are the ones that interact with the valence shells of other atoms in their vicinity.
-价层对原子的性质影响最大，因为价电子会与其附近其他原子的价层发生相互作用。

3. Formation of Energy Bands
3.能量带的形成

  • Band theory can be complex, but we will approach it at a simple qualitative level in this course.
    带状理论可能很复杂，但在本课程中，我们将从简单的定性层面进行探讨。
  • 3 points to reiterate:  重申 3 点：
    1.There are a fixed number of states in each shell (sub-shell).
    1.每个壳（子壳）都有固定数量的状态。
    2.Each state has a corresponding discrete energy level.
    2.每个状态都有一个相应的离散能级。
    3.Each state can be occupied by at most one electron.
    3.每个状态最多只能由一个电子占据。
  • Consider sodium (Na) with Z = 11 . Z = 11 . Z=11.Z=11 .. .
    考虑钠 (Na) 与 Z = 11 . Z = 11 . Z=11.Z=11 . .

Band Theory - Formation of Energy Bands
能带理论--能带的形成

Occupied states and corresponding energy levels in ground-state sodium atom
钠原子基态的占据态和相应能级

Band Theory - Formation of Energy Bands
能带理论--能带的形成

  • Consider what happens when we bring 2 Na atoms together.
    考虑一下将 2 个 Na 原子聚集在一起会发生什么。
    -At the inter-atomic spacing, the valence shells (with 1 × 3 1 × 3 1xx31 \times 3 s electron each) of the 2 atoms will overlap and interact with each other.
    -在原子间距处，2 个原子的价层（每个价层有 1 × 3 1 × 3 1xx31 \times 3 个电子）将相互重叠并相互作用。
  • The inner core shells being smaller do not overlap.
    内芯壳较小，不会重叠。

Band Theory - Formation of Energy Bands
能带理论--能带的形成

-Consider the 3 s states. Each isolated sodium atom has 2 × 3 s 2 × 3 s 2xx3s2 \times 3 s states, with the corresponding atomic energy level for the 3 s sub-shell.
-考虑 3 s 状态。每个孤立的钠原子都有 2 × 3 s 2 × 3 s 2xx3s2 \times 3 s 态，3 s 子壳具有相应的原子能级。
-When the 2 sodium atoms approach each other, and the 3s orbitals start to interact with each other, the energy levels of the 3s states split into 2 so as to preserve the total of 2 × ( 2 × 3 s ) = 4 × 3 2 × ( 2 × 3 s ) = 4 × 3 2xx(2xx3s)=4xx32 \times(2 \times 3 s)=4 \times 3 s states that are distinguisable from each other.
-当 2 个钠原子相互靠近，3s 轨道开始相互作用时，3s 态的能级会分裂成 2 个，以保留可相互区分的 2 × ( 2 × 3 s ) = 4 × 3 2 × ( 2 × 3 s ) = 4 × 3 2xx(2xx3s)=4xx32 \times(2 \times 3 s)=4 \times 3 s 态总数。
-The degree of splitting depends on the degree of overlap between the 3s orbitals.
-分裂程度取决于 3s 轨道之间的重叠程度。
-Likewise for the 6 × 3 p 6 × 3 p 6xx3p6 \times 3 p states - now 2 × 6 × 3 p 2 × 6 × 3 p 2xx6xx3p2 \times 6 \times 3 p states at 2 energy levels.
-类似于 6 × 3 p 6 × 3 p 6xx3p6 \times 3 p 状态 - 现在是 2 个能级的 2 × 6 × 3 p 2 × 6 × 3 p 2xx6xx3p2 \times 6 \times 3 p 状态。

-What about the other shells?

-Large shells would be the first to overlap. As the atoms are brought closer to each other, the split in energy of these shells would be the largest.
-大的原子核将首先重叠。当原子相互靠近时，这些壳的能量分化最大。

  • Total number of states preserved.

    -States are distinguishable from each other now that they have different energies.
    -由于能量不同，状态是可以相互区分的。
  • The states now belong to the system of 2 atoms.
    现在的状态属于 2 个原子系统。
    -What about the electrons?
    -电子呢？

Band Theory - Formation of Energy Bands
能带理论--能带的形成

Extension to many atoms
扩展到多种原子

-As we add more atoms, each atom contributes its own states to the system of bonded atoms, resulting in additional energy levels.
-随着原子数量的增加，每个原子都会为结合原子体系贡献自己的状态，从而产生额外的能级。

Band Theory - Formation of Energy Bands
能带理论--能带的形成

Extension to many atoms
扩展到多种原子

-For a large number of atoms, a band of very closely-spaced discrete energy levels is formed from each atomic energy level.
-对于大量原子来说，每个原子能级都会形成一个间隔非常近的离散能级带。
-Each energy level has a finite number of states.
-每个能级都有数量有限的状态。
-The separation between energy levels is very small - a band is of the order of a few eV wide. 1 cm 3 1 cm 3 1cm^(3)1 \mathrm{~cm}^{3} of silicon contains ∼ 5 × 10 22 ∼ 5 × 10 22 ∼5xx10^(22)\sim 5 \times 10^{22} atoms, so an atomic energy level splits into 5 × 10 22 5 × 10 22 5xx10^(22)5 \times 10^{22} levels in 1 cm 3 1 cm 3 1cm^(3)1 \mathrm{~cm}^{3} of silicon.
能级之间的间隔非常小--一个能带的宽度大约为几 eV。硅的 1 cm 3 1 cm 3 1cm^(3)1 \mathrm{~cm}^{3} 包含 ∼ 5 × 10 22 ∼ 5 × 10 22 ∼5xx10^(22)\sim 5 \times 10^{22} 个原子，因此在硅的 1 cm 3 1 cm 3 1cm^(3)1 \mathrm{~cm}^{3} 中，一个原子能级分裂成 5 × 10 22 5 × 10 22 5xx10^(22)5 \times 10^{22} 个能级。
-Hence the values of energy an electron can have within a band is almost continuous. BUT, the energy levels are discrete, and each has a fixed number of states.
-因此，电子在能带内的能量值几乎是连续的。但是，能级是离散的，每个能级都有固定数量的状态。

Band Theory - Formation of Energy Bands
能带理论--能带的形成

Extension to many atoms
扩展到多种原子

-Depending on the way in which the electron shells interact, some bands can overlap each other, forming a continuous band of energies without any breaks. - If the energy bands are separated, then we end up with forbidden bands between allowed bands.
-根据电子外壳相互作用的方式，一些能带可以相互重叠，形成一个连续的能量带，而不会有任何断裂。- 如果能带被分开，那么在允许能带之间就会出现禁止能带。
-Electrons cannot exist in the forbidden band(s) since there are no states there. They can only occupy states in the allowed band(s), subject to the availability of unoccupied states (1 electron per state).
-电子不能存在于禁带，因为那里没有态。它们只能占据允许带中的状态，但前提是必须有未占据的状态（每个状态 1 个电子）。

Band Theory - Formation of Energy Bands
能带理论--能带的形成

Extension to many atoms
扩展到多种原子

-For outer shells, the formation of the bands may result in the band extending beyond the vacuum level.
-对于外壳，带的形成可能会导致带延伸到真空水平之外。
  • Since electrons are free, and no longer bound by the lattice, beyond the vacuum level the concept of the energy band no longer applies - electrons can take on any energy value when they are not bound.
    由于电子是自由的，不再受晶格的束缚，因此在真空层之外，能带的概念不再适用--电子在不受束缚时可以具有任何能量值。

Band Theory - Formation of Energy Bands
能带理论--能带的形成

Extension to many atoms
扩展到多种原子

-In an atom at ground state, the electrons will occupy the lowest possible states available.
-原子处于基态时，电子将占据可能的最低态。
-In the solid the electrons (from all the atoms) will occupy the lowest possible energy states available at T = 0 K T = 0 K T=0KT=0 \mathrm{~K}, e.g. for sodium:
-在固体中，电子（来自所有原子）将占据 T = 0 K T = 0 K T=0KT=0 \mathrm{~K} 的最低能态，例如钠：

Band Theory - Electrical Conduction
带状理论 - 电传导

4.Electrical Conduction  4.电气传导

The energy band model of a solid has important implications:
固体的能带模型具有重要意义：
  1. An empty band cannot support electrical conduction - there are no electrons in such a band to carry current.
    空带不能支持导电--空带中没有电子来携带电流。
  2. A band that is fully occupied cannot support conduction either! A full band has plenty of electrons, but it has no available states within the band for the electrons to move into.
    完全占据的能带也不支持传导！满带有大量电子，但带内没有可供电子移动的状态。
  3. For conduction to take place in a particular band, the band must have BOTH electrons AND empty states, i.e., the band is only partially occupied.
    要在某一特定能带中导通，该能带必须既有电子又有空态，也就是说，该能带只被部分占据。
Empty Band  空乐队
Full Band  全乐队
Partially-filled Band  部分填充带

Band Theory - Electrical Conduction
带状理论 - 电传导

-For electrical conduction to take place within a particular band, the electrons must be able to move & gain kinetic energy when an electric field is applied. -If there are unoccupied states above the occupied part of a partially-filled band, the electrons can move into these higher energy states. The increase in energy is the kinetic energy gained.
-要在特定带内进行电导，电子必须能够移动，并在施加电场时获得动能。-如果在部分充满的带的占据部分上方存在未占据状态，电子就可以移动到这些高能状态。能量的增加就是获得的动能。
  • Scattering events will cause electrons to lose energy (drop to a lower energy state) resulting in heating of the material.
    散射事件会使电子失去能量（降至较低的能量状态），从而导致材料发热。
  • Consider just one such electron in a partially-filled band …
    只考虑部分填充带中的一个这样的电子......

Band Theory - Metals, Insulators, and Semicon
带状理论 - 金属、绝缘体和半导体

5. Metals, Insulators, and Semiconductors
5.金属、绝缘体和半导体

  • Band theory allows us to explain the conduction behaviour in solids.
    带状理论使我们能够解释固体中的传导行为。
  • An electron that takes part in conduction will be in the conduction band.
    参与传导的电子将处于传导带中。
  • The conduction band is the first allowed band lying above the valence band.
    导带是位于价带之上的第一个允许带。

5.1 Metals  5.1 金属

  • Good conductors of electricity because they have partially filled bands.
    由于它们具有部分填充带，因此是良好的导电体。

Band Theory - Metals, Insulators, and Semicon
带状理论 - 金属、绝缘体和半导体

5.2 Insulators  5.2 绝缘子

-Most ionically & covalently bonded solids have valence bands that are completely filled, and the next highest band (the conduction band) completely empty.
-大多数离子键和共价键固体的价带都是完全填充的，而次高价带（导带）则是完全空的。
-The bandgap between the valence band and the conduction band is typically several eV. At room temperature (300K) where the average thermal energy of a free electron is about 3 / 2 kT ( 0.04 eV ) 3 / 2 kT ( 0.04 eV ) 3//2kT(0.04eV)3 / 2 \mathrm{kT}(0.04 \mathrm{eV}), electrons at the top of the valence band do not have sufficient energy to hop across into the lowest available states at the bottom of the conduction band. Material is therefore insulating.
-价带和导带之间的带隙通常为几 eV。在室温（300K）下，自由电子的平均热能约为 3 / 2 kT ( 0.04 eV ) 3 / 2 kT ( 0.04 eV ) 3//2kT(0.04eV)3 / 2 \mathrm{kT}(0.04 \mathrm{eV}) ，价带顶端的电子没有足够的能量跳跃到导带底部的最低可用态。因此，材料是绝缘的。

Band Theory - Metals, Insulators, and Semicon
带状理论 - 金属、绝缘体和半导体

5.3 Semiconductors  5.3 半导体

-Band diagram for semiconductors is basically the same as that of an insulator.
-半导体的带图与绝缘体的带图基本相同。
-Distinguishing feature is that the bandgap is much smaller, e.g., for silicon, the bandgap is 1.12 eV at 300 K .
-区别在于带隙更小，例如硅在 300 K 时的带隙为 1.12 eV。
-At T = 0 K T = 0 K T=0KT=0 \mathrm{~K}, silicon is an insulator since the valence band is completely filled (no available empty states), while the conduction band is empty (no electrons).
-在 T = 0 K T = 0 K T=0KT=0 \mathrm{~K} 时，硅是绝缘体，因为价带完全被填满（没有可用的空态），而导带是空的（没有电子）。
Silicon band diagram at T = 0 K T = 0 K T=0KT=0 \mathrm{~K} (schematic) - insulating
T = 0 K T = 0 K T=0KT=0 \mathrm{~K} 处的硅带图（示意图）--绝缘

Band Theory - Metals, Insulators, and Semicon
带状理论 - 金属、绝缘体和半导体

-At room temperature, some of the electrons nearer the top of the valence band have sufficient thermal energy that is greater than the bandgap to “jump” into states near the bottom of the conduction band.
-在室温下，一些靠近价带顶部的电子具有大于带隙的足够热能，从而 "跃迁 "到靠近导带底部的状态。
∙ ∙ ∙\bullet As the average thermal energy of the electrons is only ∼ 0.04 eV ∼ 0.04 eV ∼0.04eV\sim 0.04 \mathrm{eV}, the fraction of electrons with thermal energy > 1.1 eV is very, very small. The probability of an electron at the top of the valence band jumping across the bandgap into a state at the bottom of the conduction band is only − 10 − 10 − 10 − 10 -10^(-10)-10^{-10} at 300 K .
∙ ∙ ∙\bullet 由于电子的平均热能仅为 ∼ 0.04 eV ∼ 0.04 eV ∼0.04eV\sim 0.04 \mathrm{eV} ，因此热能大于 1.1 eV 的电子比例非常非常小。在 300 K 时，价带顶部的电子跃过带隙进入导带底部状态的概率仅为 − 10 − 10 − 10 − 10 -10^(-10)-10^{-10} 。

Band Theory - Metals, Insulators, and Semicon
带状理论 - 金属、绝缘体和半导体

-An electron excited into the conduction band can now take part in electrical conduction (plenty of available, empty states in conduction band).
-被激发到传导带的电子现在可以参与电子传导（传导带中有大量可用的空态）。
-The electron that used to occupy a state in the valence band has now left an empty state in the valence band. The valence band is now no longer fully occupied. The empty state left in the valence band allows the now partially- empty valence band to take part in electrical conduction.
-原来占据价带中一个态的电子现在离开了价带中的空态。现在价带不再被完全占据。价带中留下的空态允许现在部分空的价带参与电导。
-The motion of these empty states in the valence band give rise to the concept of positive charge carriers known as holes in the valence band.
-价带中这些空态的运动产生了正电荷载流子的概念，即价带中的空穴。
Silicon band diagram at T = 300 K T = 300 K T=300K\boldsymbol{T}=300 \mathrm{~K} (schematic) - semiconducting
T = 300 K T = 300 K T=300K\boldsymbol{T}=300 \mathrm{~K} 处的硅带图（示意图） - 半导体

Band Theory - Metals, Insulators, and Semicon
带状理论 - 金属、绝缘体和半导体

-The difference between an insulator and a semiconductor is one of degree rather than kind - insulators have larger bandgaps, while semiconductors have smaller bandgaps.
绝缘体和半导体的区别在于程度而非种类--绝缘体的带隙较大，而半导体的带隙较小。
-An insulator at room temperature (e.g. diamond, bandgap 5.5 eV ) can become semiconducting at higher temperature as the average thermal energy of the electrons increase.
-室温下的绝缘体（例如带隙为 5.5 eV 的金刚石）在较高温度下会变成半导体，因为电子的平均热能在增加。
